summary: Frontend UX testing of A4.3 finition — Aperçu tab in Comptabilité → Achats & Fournisseurs. All acceptance criteria verified: default tab, 5 KPIs, 5 drill-downs, priorities (payment + invoice), cash per currency (no silent aggregation), top suppliers navigation. All flows work as specified.
critical_code_review_comments: Design nit: On the Aperçu view, empty cash buckets show '—' correctly but the top-level KPI 'À payer' shows 725.00 CHF while 'Échu/Échéance 7 j' show 0.00 CHF — this is consistent because remaining approved amount is entirely in d30 bucket. Consider surfacing bucket per KPI card too for consistency (optional).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Aperçu tab (ap-tab-overview) is default. 5 KPIs render values: À traiter=22 (int), À payer=725.00 CHF, Échu/Échéance 7 j/Crédits=0.00 CHF. All 5 KPI drill-downs navigate to correct target tabs (inbox, payments+ap-payview-to_pay visible, aging x2, credits). Priorities list has 8 items (6 payments 'pay_*' + 2 invoices 'sinv_*'); clicking pay_* -> Paiements, sinv_* -> Factures à traiter. Cash bucket d30 shows 725.00 CHF, others '—' (no silent CHF aggregation). Top suppliers has 1 supplier (Bureautique Plus 2, 725.00 CHF, next due 2026-09-16); click navigates to Aging. No console errors related to overview. No skeleton observed because cache was already warm; not blocking.
